one_line: Two rival rulers at the end of Western Kshatrapa power and the rise of the Gupta empire in western India, c. 400 CE.

appearance.age_look: late 30s, athletic and battle-seasoned, average height but broad-shouldered
appearance.face: Oval face with sharp jaw, wheatish-brown complexion, straight nose, neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, keen dark eyes with a calm but determined gaze; default expression is focused and dignified, as if judging a battlefield.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair pulled back and gathered into a low, tidy knot at the back of the head, front kept smooth with a narrow gold headband circling the forehead and a small central disc resting above the brow.
appearance.costume: Layered, historically grounded hybrid of late Western Kshatrapa–Gupta martial attire: an inner long-sleeved, knee-length white cotton tunic with a round neck and thin red piping, over which sits a fitted, sleeveless dark crimson cotton jerkin reinforced with subtle quilted stitching; below, a mustard-yellow cotton dhoti wrapped tightly for riding and combat, pleated in front and tied at the waist, falling to the ankles; over the left shoulder and wrapped around the torso is a deep indigo-blue cotton uttariya (shawl) draped diagonally, its borders decorated with simple repeating geometric motifs in dull gold; at the waist, a sturdy brown leather belt with a bronze buckle, from which hangs a small dagger scabbard; legs are covered by the dhoti and simple off-white cotton leggings underneath for riding comfort; feet in brown leather strapped sandals; jewelry is restrained: a pair of small, round gold stud earrings, a single flat gold neck torque close to the collarbone, and one plain gold armlet on the right upper arm, reflecting both Kshatrapa and Gupta elite styles while remaining practical for a warrior-king.
appearance.signature: A single long steel sword in a plain brown leather scabbard with minimal bronze fittings, worn at the left hip and occasionally drawn as a gently curving, single-edged blade with a simple crossguard and a wrapped dark-brown hilt.

ref_desc: Athletic late-30s warrior-king with wheatish complexion, neat beard, black hair in a low knot with a narrow gold headband, wearing a white tunic, dark crimson sleeveless jerkin, mustard-yellow dhoti, deep indigo uttariya, minimal gold jewelry, brown leather sandals, and carrying a long steel sword at his left hip.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of an athletic late-30s Indian warrior-king from c. 400 CE with a wheatish-brown oval face, sharp jaw, straight nose, keen dark eyes, and a neat short beard and moustache, his thick black hair pulled into a low knot at the back and encircled by a narrow gold headband with a small central disc above the brow; dress him in a knee-length white cotton long-sleeved tunic with thin red piping, over it a fitted sleeveless dark crimson quilted jerkin, a tightly wrapped mustard-yellow cotton dhoti falling to the ankles with off-white leggings beneath, and a deep indigo-blue cotton uttariya draped diagonally over his left shoulder and around the torso with simple dull-gold geometric border motifs; add a brown leather belt with a bronze buckle, a small dagger scabbard, simple brown leather strapped sandals, small round gold stud earrings, a flat gold neck torque, and a single gold armlet on the right upper arm; have him carry a long steel sword in a plain brown leather scabbard with minimal bronze fittings at his left hip, and show his costume and weapon clearly from head to toe with consistent colours of deep indigo, dark crimson, mustard yellow, white, and brown leather.
